PF Withdrawal Rules Under Scrutiny Amid Conflicting Claims

The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) is facing scrutiny over its withdrawal rules, with some claiming the new system will lead to delays and others hailing it as a positive change. The EPFO has announced plans to introduce a new system for withdrawing PF advances, but critics argue that this may result in longer processing times. On the other hand, some outlets have reported that the new system is expected to be more efficient and faster than before.
